watch.summary: The creator reacts to footage from a humanoid robot competition and jokingly warns that the robot apocalypse is imminent.

beats.what: Creator watches robots playing ping pong and riding robotic dogs.
Creator declares humanity is in the end times and disguising the takeover as 'Robot Olympics'.
Creator panics that humans are actively ushering in robotic overlords.
Creator decides he is moving back to Nigeria because the West is cooked.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Because this, the West is cooked!
watch.why: The creator builds comedic momentum by overreacting to clunky robot competition clips as if they were a terrifying dystopian threat. His exaggerated panic culminates in a funny personal exit strategy from the 'cooked' West.
